record.question: As the sun appeared, the fog began to disappear.
record.explanation: Answer D: Adverbial Clause of Time. “As the sun appeared” gives the time at which the fog began to disappear (D). Independent check: “As the sun appeared” tells when the fog began to disappear, so it is a time clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
